title: Item: SixxCoin (bag)
content:
Reward from Graz'zt / Mr. Sixx in Gracklstugh
1000g given to EACH: Daterra, Perry, and Sig. Jib refused, Kronk missed that session. 
A magic bag of coins that MUST be tracked separately from regular money. Other money can be added to it, but that must then be considered SixxCoin and tracked with this.
